intro.title: Meet the 007
paragraphs: The DongFeng 007 is engineered for those who demand more from every drive. With a striking silhouette and commanding road presence, the 007 delivers executive-level refinement paired with exhilarating electric performance.

From the boardroom to the open road, the 007 combines rapid acceleration, long-range capability and cutting-edge technology into a seamless driving experience that sets a new benchmark for electric sedans.

features.title: Crystal LED Headlights
features.description: Bold, angular LED headlights cut through the darkness with razor-sharp clarity, giving the 007 an unmistakable front-end identity that commands attention day and night.

features.title: Interactive Tail Lights
features.description: Dynamic LED tail lights respond to driving conditions with animated sequences, creating a signature light show that enhances visibility and leaves a lasting impression.

features.title: Sleek Frameless Doors
features.description: Frameless door architecture lends the 007 a streamlined profile, reducing wind noise at speed while delivering an effortlessly premium feel every time you step inside.

sections.title: Choose Your Statement
sections.subtitle: From understated elegance to bold confidence, find the shade that matches your character.

features.title: Central Control System
features.description: A sweeping high-resolution touchscreen places every vehicle function at your fingertips, from navigation and media to climate and vehicle settings, all through an intuitive interface.

features.title: WANOS Audio System
features.description: Immerse yourself in concert-quality sound with the WANOS surround audio system, delivering rich, detailed acoustics precisely tuned to the cabin's dimensions.

features.title: Wireless Phone Charger
features.description: Drop your phone onto the integrated charging pad and stay powered throughout every journey, no cables, no fuss, just seamless convenience.

features.title: Fast Charging
features.description: With ultra-rapid DC charging support, the 007 recovers substantial range in minutes, turning a quick stop into hundreds of additional kilometres.

features.title: Electric Hatch Liftgate
features.description: A hands-free electric liftgate opens and closes at the tap of a button or a wave of your foot, making loading and unloading effortless even with your hands full.

sections.title: Confidence at Every Turn
sections.subtitle: The 007 wraps you in layers of intelligent protection, anticipating hazards before they become a threat.

features.title: Adaptive Cruise Control
features.description: Automatically adjusts your cruising speed to match traffic flow, maintaining a safe following distance so you can cover long distances with reduced fatigue.

features.title: Intelligent Brake Assist
features.description: When the system detects an imminent collision, it pre-charges the brakes and applies maximum stopping force to help you avoid or minimise impact.

features.title: Lane Departure Warning
features.description: Continuously tracks road markings and gently alerts you if the vehicle drifts from its lane without a turn signal, keeping you safely on course.

features.title: Comfy Eco Friendly Cabin
features.description: Step into a cabin where premium recycled materials and soft-touch surfaces create an environment that feels luxurious while respecting the planet.

features.title: Colour Ambient Lighting
features.description: Set the mood with a spectrum of customisable ambient lighting that bathes the cabin in colour, transforming the atmosphere to suit your drive.

features.title: Leather Steering Wheel
features.description: A hand-stitched leather steering wheel offers a refined grip and tactile feedback, putting precise control and everyday comfort right at your fingertips.

features.title: Piano Lacquer Finish Buttons
features.description: Glossy piano lacquer trim on the centre console buttons adds a touch of sophistication, elevating the interior with a detail that looks and feels premium.
